AutoScalingGroup.description: Identifies the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group that Image Builder takes the build instance from, and how long Image Builder waits when the group has no instance available.

CapacityWaitTimeoutSeconds.description: The number of seconds that Image Builder waits for an instance to become available in the group before the build fails. If you set this value to 0 or omit it, the build fails as soon as the group has no instance available.

Name.description: The name of the Auto Scaling group, in the same account and AWS Region as the infrastructure configuration.

InstanceMetadataOptions.description: The instance metadata option settings for the infrastructure configuration.

HttpPutResponseHopLimit.description: Limit the number of hops that an instance metadata request can traverse to reach its destination.

TerminateInstanceOnCompletion.description: Specifies whether Image Builder terminates build and test instances that are still running when image creation ends without a failure. A TerminateInstance step in a workflow runs even when this is false.

TerminateInstanceOnFailure.description: The terminate instance on failure configuration of the infrastructure configuration.
